title: Glowing snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Base of snow globe -->
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='40' height='16' rx='5' fill='#B06A2A'/>
  <rect x='32' y='80' width='36' height='5' rx='2' fill='#D4893C'/>
  <rect x='32' y='87' width='36' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#D4893C'/>
  <!-- Base highlight -->
  <rect x='36' y='81' width='28' height='2' rx='1' fill='#F0B060'/>

  <!-- Globe glass sphere -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#1A3A5C'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#2B6B9E' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Inner glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='#3A8CC8' opacity='0.35'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='20' fill='#5AAADD' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Snow ground inside globe -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='8' fill='#E8F4FF'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='20' ry='6' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Little house inside globe -->
  <rect x='44' y='56' width='12' height='10' fill='#C94A4A'/>
  <polygon points='42,56 50,48 58,56' fill='#E86B6B'/>
  <rect x='47' y='60' width='3' height='6' fill='#FFD966'/>
  <!-- Window -->
  <rect x='51' y='59' width='3' height='3' fill='#FFE88C'/>
  <!-- House shadow -->
  <rect x='52' y='56' width='4' height='10' fill='#A03838' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Snowman inside globe -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='63' r='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='57' r='3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='52' r='2.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Snowman hat -->
  <rect x='33.5' y='49.5' width='5' height='2' rx='0.5' fill='#333366'/>
  <rect x='34.5' y='48' width='3' height='2' rx='0.3' fill='#333366'/>
  <!-- Snowman eye -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='51.5' r='0.5' fill='#333366'/>
  <!-- Snowman carrot nose -->
  <polygon points='38,52 39.5,52.5 38,53' fill='#FF8833'/>

  <!-- Snowflakes falling -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='30' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='45' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='28' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='42' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='58' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='52' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='35' r='0.7' fill='#C8E8FF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='0.9' fill='#C8E8FF'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='48' r='0.8' fill='#C8E8FF'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Stars/dots inside globe -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='0.8' fill='#FFE88C'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='44' r='0.7' fill='#FFE88C'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='0.6' fill='#FFE88C'/>

  <!-- Globe glass shine highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='38' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.15' transform='rotate(-20 40 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='36' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.2' transform='rotate(-20 38 36)'/>

  <!-- Base glow line -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='20' ry='3' fill='#FFD966' opacity='0.3'/>
</svg>
